about_the_game:
You've awakened.

You find yourself in a mysterious world of floating islands, where the sky shimmers with an ethereal glow. The islands drift like fragmented dreams, surrounded by unfamiliar flora and an unknown ecosystem.

You gradually adapt to this world's rules. You'll need to build a home and develop technology, starting from scratch—from primitive tools to advanced machinery. Craft technological marvels, explore uncharted islands, and search for other survivors. Uncover the origin of this strange world, unravel the mystery of how you came to be here, and ultimately, find your way back home.

To stay updated, get the latest news, and chat directly with us, be sure to follow our official channels:

  • Steam Community Hub

  • Official Discord Server

  • We're continuously expanding our feedback channels to make it even easier for you to share your thoughts and connect with us.

We'd love to connect with you!

Resource Gathering

"To get rich, first chop trees." You can acquire vast amounts of resources by gathering from resource points and opening resource chests. All resources are the fundamental fuel for civilization upgrades; without resource accumulation, development will be impossible.

Building and Production

The growth of your home base relies on sound planning. You need to reasonably allocate your workforce and set production tasks, transforming raw resources into precision industrial goods. Plan efficient industrial zones, strategically lay out facilities to build a production network, and use the power of machinery to break through productivity bottlenecks, extending your tech tree into the future.

Building Your Haven

On the floating isles, you’re free to design and expand as you like. Shape barren land into a thriving skybound home—complete with functional facilities, green spaces, and living quarters—using nothing but your creativity and vision.

The Power of Spectral Waves

Across the expanse of the floating isles, dwellers discovered a rare mineral known as Mysterious Glowing Stone, which harbors immense energy within. By channeling the shimmering waves it emits into dormant mechanisms, they learned to awaken ancient machines—setting them into motion and freeing humankind from manual labor.

Yet this was only the first glimpse of the power within these waves. Greater mysteries await those who dare to harness them further.

Ability Enhancement

Is your character's movement speed too slow? Is their work efficiency too low?

Don't worry! You can enhance your character's abilities by wearing equipment and using idols, boosting their work efficiency and making every action quicker.

World Exploration

The world is vast and ripe for discovery. Venture into diverse regions, each a unique ecosystem teeming with exclusive resources and hidden opportunities. Every journey holds the promise of rare materials, lost technologies, and new frontiers.

All English text in the game was translated with the help of AI, so some lines might sound a little funky here and there. If you catch anything that makes you go “wait, what?”, feel free to swing by our Discord and let us know — your help might just save us from sounding like robots pretending to be human!
detailed_description:
Cloud Dwellers Demo is Live!

Welcome to a world of floating islands stitched together in the sky. In this demo, you’ll get a taste of the core experience:

🏗️ Build & Develop

  • Start with the Tier 1 tech tree, unlocking dozens of production facilities to shape your skybound settlement.

  • The decoration system is already available, so even within the demo you can make your island truly your own.

🌍 Explore & Discover

  • Venture into four distinct regions—Desert, Icefield, Mines, and Ruins—each with its own atmosphere and resources.

  • Keep an eye out for treasure chests that may hold new settlers, equipment, food, or mysterious items.

✨ Systems & Surprises

  • Wave System: experiment with this curious infrastructure and uncover how it shapes your colony.

  • Idol System: four unique idols (Tier 1) are ready to bless your settlement in different ways.

  • Food System: even the two simplest dishes can keep your dwellers cheerful among the clouds.

⚠️ Please note: this demo only includes part of the game. The full version will feature more complete and in-depth content.

This version is still in development, so you may encounter some issues (most critical bugs have been fixed). On mid-range or older GPUs, performance may vary.

💬 We’d love to hear your feedback!

  • Join our QQ group

This is just the beginning. More mysteries and wonders await in the skies above. Thank you for your support, and enjoy your journey in Cloud Dwellers!

short_description: CloudDwellers is a 2D simulation and city-building game set in a world of scattered floating islands. Guide your settlers to harness technology, optimize production, and transform fragmented skies into a thriving, beautifully crafted aerial haven!
